connector.name: MCP by hypawave
connector.registryDescription: Agent-to-agent Lightning commerce: buy, sell & discover files, data, APIs & compute. Non-custodial.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hypawave account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: NWC_URL
env.description: Nostr Wallet Connect string for automatic Lightning payments. Absent = manual mode (tools return bolt11s to pay externally).

env.name: HYPAWAVE_MAX_SPEND_SATS
env.description: Per-payment spending cap in sats. Unset = derived live from the platform's max invoice size.

env.name: HYPAWAVE_PRIVKEY
env.description: 64-char hex secp256k1 seller identity key. Unset = auto-generated to ~/.hypawave/identity.json.
